title: Saint Neophytos Enkleistra

groundCutout.basis: The small entrance recess is excavated into the cliff above the preserved terrace.

buildingCutout.basis: The underlying cliffside range is the presently mapped footprint that registers the historical enclosure.

terrainReference.basis: Native Copernicus bilinear height at the estimated historical stair and bridge approach, before authored stonework.

identities.name: Saint Neophytos Enkleistra
identities.address: Enkleistra, Agios Neophytos Monastery, Tala, Paphos District, Cyprus

mapIdentity.scope: Current cliffside building outline and position from the native map. The 1888 photograph defines the earlier approach and the projecting enclosure of the original hermitage. The modern surface raster supports the approach level and coarse cliff elevation.

note: The 1888 plate shows a masonry arched structure, adjacent plastered wall, elevated retaining terrace, diagonal outdoor stair, bridge and irregular cliff directly behind the buildings.
